Less in the way. More on the page.

A little room goes a long way.

01

Stay with the thought

A clean writing space, light or dark. Your outline waits in the margin. Your pages save as you go.

Focus, by design
02

Find the next possibility

Press ⌘J to discover what you can do. Find a table, an equation or a familiar action, and learn its shortcut as you go.

⌘ J
03

Begin somewhere interesting

Start with a blank page, a guided introduction or a template from the community. Explore a whole book, then make it your own.

⌘ N
04

Keep your words yours

Your writing lives in ordinary files on your Mac. Compare recent snapshots, return to an earlier draft, and export a finished PDF when you're ready.

A quiet corner of the web.

This website uses no analytics, advertising trackers or third-party fonts. Your language and appearance choices stay in your browser. Our hosting provider handles the network information needed to deliver the page. Links to GitHub take you to a separate service.
